facts.where: 4 Judges and runs
facts.quote: Judges and runs. Four judges were run on all six primary contexts with the same links and decoys: Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.5 through the Kaggle Benchmarks proxy, and Gemma 4 26B through Google’s API at temperature 0.
facts.note: a benchmark proxy that sets temperature and seed itself and does not report them (output cap 4,000 tokens, system and user text sent as two messages); not a registered route term and not the maker's API; no reasoning effort written

facts.quote: Seven reviewers judged the same items: llama3.1:8b , qwen2.5:7b , qwen2.5:14b , gemma-4-26b-a4b-it , gemini-3.5-flash-lite (on R0 , R2 and R4 only), qwen2.5:32b and Claude Opus 4.5, with greedy decoding except for Claude, which ran through a proxy that sets temperature and seed itself.
facts.note: "A closed hosted model, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, is a secondary model on R0, R2 and R4 only"; "Flash-Lite" in Table 1; greedy decoding (temperature 0), output cap 1024 tokens; hosted route not named; GA or preview not stated
